ingest_token.title: Ingest token
ingest_token.description: Per-org or per-member ingest token issued by the TrustModel console. When present, the extension reports this device's AI usage to the org with zero user action.

email.title: Work email
email.description: Optional: the employee's work email, when the MDM can template it.

org_id.title: Organization ID
org_id.description: Optional: the TrustModel organization id, for display.
